# nanoflags_environments (Data Source)

Lists a project's environments in dashboard order, e.g. to configure a flag in every environment with `for_each`. Any valid token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nanoflags_environments" "web" {
  project = "web"
}

# Turn a flag on in every environment.
resource "nanoflags_flag_environment" "banner" {
  for_each    = toset(data.nanoflags_environments.web.keys)
  project     = "web"
  flag        = "maintenance-banner"
  environment = each.key
  enabled     = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project` (String) Project key or id.

### Read-Only

- `environments` (Attributes List) The environments. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--environments))
- `keys` (List of String) Environment keys in order.

<a id="nestedatt--environments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `environments`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Environment id (UUID).
- `is_protected` (Boolean) Protected environment.
- `key` (String) Environment key (or id when looking one up).
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `published_at` (String) Time of the last publish.
- `published_checksum` (String) Checksum of the published revision.
- `published_revision` (Number) Published revision (0 when nothing was published).
- `require_approval` (Boolean) Publishing needs an approved change.
- `require_scenarios` (Boolean) Publishing needs passing scenario checks.
- `required_approvers` (Number) Independent approvals needed.
- `sort` (Number) Position in the dashboard.
